source: The phrase low-rank should be interpreted relative to the large full K/V projection space. The latent does not have to be smaller than one individual head dimension. In ZXNAME0000XZ, for example,ZXMATH0000XZ = 128 whileZXMATH0001XZ = 512. What matters is that 512 is far below the full 128-head content width ZXMATH0002XZ
zh: 短语“低秩”应该相对于大的完整 K/V 投影空间来解释。潜伏不必小于一个单独的头部尺寸。以ZXNAME0000XZ为例，ZXMATH0000XZ = 128，而ZXMATH0001XZ = 512。重要的是512远低于完整的128头内容宽度ZXMATH0002XZ
